_note: SPEC.md B2. FMD/HS/BQ/Brucella timings and funding are from DAHD / NADCP-LHDCP. Deworming interval is common field practice and is marked as such. This file drives Day Zero (blueprint 4.1): adding one animal writes future events immediately, so the timeline is never empty.
_verify_before_demo: Confirm intervals with the district veterinary officer. Wrong dates here are the one bug a vet judge will catch instantly.
_species_note: One mechanism only: every species word an animal record can hold must appear in `aliases` and resolve to a key in `schedules`. There is deliberately no second species-group map, because two sources of truth is how 'cow' ended up resolving to nothing.
